conservation.condition_narrative: Museum files record inscriptions on destroyed labels and markings written by others but recorded by Felrath Hines when he wax-lined the work. "On Stretcher: This picture can be varnished with Winsor Newton/picture mastic varnish after October 1923" (unidentified hand, graphite). . . Georgia O'Keeffe [illegible words] Texas / Red Barn, Lake George, N.Y. / 1921 (unidentified hand, graphite).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); (The Anderson Galleries, New York, NY, auction, lot no. 49, 23 February 1922); Herschel V. Jones, Minneapolis, Minnesota, 1922; [. . .]; (Ferargil Gallery, New York, NY); Alfred H. Holbrook, New York, NY, 1944 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, 'Bought from Feragil [*sic*] by Mr. Alfred H. Holbrook. Given to the University of Georgia by Mr. Holbrook may 1945. Infor. From O'Keeffe: Sold at auction at Anderson Gals, 1922 to a Mr. Jones who had some connection with the *Minneapolis Star*. He paid $350... Identified by Miss O'Keeffe and also by Mr. Holbrook from tracing of photo. and description." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1922, but the painting was auctioned in February 1922. Either this or cat. nos. 617, 618 mentioned in the *New York Times* (January 1932) at Reinhardt Galleries. O'Keeffe wrote: "There was a fine old barn at the Lake George farmhouse... I have looked at the barn in summer and have looked at it in the winter when the snow was deep ... (*Georgia O'Keeffe* [1976], unpaginated, text accompanying entry 44). Titled *The Red Barns – Lake George* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
